about: How sure a fact must be (FACT_CERTAINTY, issue #542): what each level changes, with made-up songs. 'match' cases go through the scored match (work-resolver.ts BARS); each article's text is followed by ten filler sentences in the test. 'ranking' cases go through rankFacts (fact-ranking.ts FLOORS). 'standard' is today's result at every case.
